name: duet
description: How Claude Duet works, written for the Claude agents running inside it: where plugins come from and when they load, how channels, threads and sessions relate, and how a channel's repos are attached, how scheduled routines behave, how messages split into bubbles, how to tell two accounts' connector tools apart, when to give complex multi-task work its own channel, how to keep Linear tickets up to date as work moves, and how to look for and try coupon codes at checkout. Install it to your claude.ai chat plugins so every new Duet thread and channel starts out knowing. Grows one skill at a time as new Duet behavior is learned.
